雅思周末复习 · 第 2 周（10 月 31 日 周六）

这周五天（10 月 26 日到 30 日）的内容都在这一页里，大概 60 分钟。建议顺序：单词 15 分钟，听写 10 分钟，听力表达 5 分钟，阅读 15 分钟，写作口语 15 分钟。不用联网，手机上也能用。

1. 单词自测（15 分钟）

本周主词表 113 个，按天分组（有 12 个词几天都出现过，只放在第一次出现那天）。点卡片任意位置播放英音，点中文可以单独显示或隐藏。中文默认是隐藏的（显示“点击显示”），先看英文说意思，说不出来再点开。每天下面还有听前难词（共 40 个，跟主词表重复的已经去掉），有时间再刷。

15 个本周主词表里容易拼错的词，每天 3 个。点“播放”听发音，在框里打出单词，点“检查”看对不对（大小写不影响）。灰色小字是中文提示，想加难度就别看。

  1. 提示：传染性的；会传染的
  2. 提示：症状
  3. 提示：刺激（皮肤）；激怒

  5. 提示：故意地，有意地
  6. 提示：完美主义
  7. 提示：营养物质，营养素
  8. 提示：补充剂，保健品
  9. 提示：不幸地，可惜
  10. 提示：沉浸，浸入
  11. 提示：重复

  13. 提示：排放，排放物
  14. 提示：文明
  15. 提示：可持续的

3. 听力表达回顾（5 分钟）

五集 BBC 6 Minute English，共 24 个重点表达。中文默认隐藏，先自己想意思再点开。斜体是节目原文里主持人解释这个表达的那句话。

完整音频和原文都在每天的早间页面里（10-26 到 10-30 早间），这里为了文件小没有再放进来。哪集表达忘得多，就回那天页面再听一遍。

周一 10月26日：Why do we itch?（9 月 24 日）

  • funny you should ask 你问得巧，正好点击显示
    Georgie: Well, funny you should ask, because I'm actually wearing quite an itchy jumper at the moment and it's making me want to scratch my skin.
  • unpack 把…讲清楚点击显示
    Georgie: Anand says there's a lot of science to unpack about itchiness. Unpack here means explain.
  • spontaneously 自发地，不假思索地点击显示
    Neil: If you do something spontaneously, you do it without being asked or without thinking.
  • get rid of 去掉，摆脱点击显示
    Neil: Sonja explains that when our skin feels itchy, we scratch it, and that helps to get rid of parasites and other harmful things on our skin.
  • spot on 完全正确点击显示
    Dr Henning Holle: It is definitely hairy skin and Anand was spot on.

周二 10月27日：Is rejection good for us?（9 月 17 日）

  • face my fears 直面恐惧点击显示
    Hannah Gelbart: Coming somewhere else to try and face my fears... maybe do a bit of shopping.
  • come easier 变得更容易点击显示
    Georgie: Each time Hannah tried to speak to a new person, she says, it came easier. Come easier is an informal way to say something is easier to achieve.
  • appraise 评价，评判点击显示
    Neil: And if you appraise someone, you judge them.
  • shy of 不敢，怕做某事点击显示
    Claudia Hammond: And so, I wonder whether that might make people more shy of speaking to strangers.
  • counter 抵消，应对点击显示
    Claudia Hammond: ...and so doing something like this to try to counter that might feel like a positive step to people, that they're trying to do something.

周三 10月28日：What should you eat for a better night's sleep?（10 月 22 日）

  • lie there for hours 躺好几个小时睡不着点击显示
    Phil: If I've been thinking about something a lot, or even worse, if I've had a cup of coffee later than I should, sometimes I can lie there for hours.
  • be associated with 与…有关点击显示
    Georgie: ...they found that a healthier diet is associated with better quality sleep.
  • be fed information 被不断灌输信息点击显示
    Georgie: If you are fed information, you are given lots of it in a continuous way.
  • magic bullet 灵丹妙药点击显示
    Phil: ...a magic bullet refers to a simple and effective solution to a problem that's usually one that doesn't exist.

周四 10月29日：Can apps teach you a language?（9 月 10 日）

  • explicit / implicit 显性的 / 隐性的点击显示
    Pippa: Explicit is the opposite of implicit. So, for example, explicit grammar teaching would be somebody explaining a grammar rule to you.
  • immersion 沉浸点击显示
    Neil: Immersion means being completely surrounded by something.
  • key finding 主要发现点击显示
    Pippa: A key finding is the most important conclusion of a piece of research.
  • promising 有希望的点击显示
    Neil: Liz says the study is promising, which means it shows signs of being positive.
  • moving forwards 往后，今后点击显示
    Professor Elizabeth Wonnacott: Probably moving forwards, some combination of human teaching and these platforms to give us that repetition is probably going to be the right direction.

周五 10月30日：Is aircon the answer to a heating world?（10 月 29 日）

  • go-to solution 首选办法点击显示
    Dr Radhika Khosla: When air conditioning becomes the first, go-to solution for how we deal with the increased, prolonged and extreme heat...
  • the grid 电网点击显示
    Neil: The grid is the network that distributes electricity across towns, cities and countries.
  • vicious cycle / circle 恶性循环点击显示
    Georgie: And Radhika calls this a vicious cycle.
  • passive cooling 被动降温点击显示
    Neil: Passive cooling is where you cool your house down without using a lot of energy.
  • detrimental 有害的点击显示
    Dr Radhika Khosla: ...we're going to see the grid collapse. We're going to see emissions rise. We're going to see all kinds of other impacts that actually are quite detrimental.

4. 阅读易错题回顾（15 分钟）

从这周五篇 G 类阅读里挑出最容易错的题，主要是 NOT GIVEN、标题匹配干扰项、单复数和选项框里的干扰词。先看原文片段，自己判断，再点开答案。虚线词点一下显示中文。

判断题口诀：原文说反了是 FALSE，原文没说是 NOT GIVEN。填空题记得核对单复数和字数要求，选项框题要排除原文没出现的词。

周一 Section 1：社区学院课程广告 + 图书馆会员新规

The fee covers all tools and materials, and overalls are provided.

Q2. Which course includes the cost of all equipment in the fee?（A Photography　B Car Maintenance　C Spanish　D First Aid　E Cooking）

点开看答案

B　all equipment = all tools and materials。E 课食材要另交 £5，别选错。

You take home whatever you cook, so remember to bring some containers.

Q3. Which course asks students to bring something to carry items home?（A Photography　B Car Maintenance　C Spanish　D First Aid　E Cooking）

点开看答案

E　carry items home 对应 take home + bring containers。A 课也要带相机，但那不是用来带东西回家的。

However, adults will continue to pay 20p per day for each overdue item…

Q11. Adults will no longer be charged for returning items late.

点开看答案

FALSE　取消罚款的只是儿童书，成人还要交，FALSE。别被第一句 removed completely 带偏。

On a trial basis, the library will open on Sundays from 10 am to 4 pm until the end of March.

Q12. The library will definitely continue opening on Sundays after March.

点开看答案

NOT GIVEN　只说试行到三月底，之后会不会继续原文没说，NOT GIVEN。definitely 是陷阱词。

Photo identification is not required.

Q14. New members must show a passport or driving licence.

点开看答案

FALSE　护照和驾照都是带照片的证件，原文说不需要，FALSE。

周二 Section 2：酒店新员工手册 + 安全搬运（标题匹配 + 笔记填空）

All new employees are given two sets of uniform… Jewellery should be kept to a minimum…

Q1. Section A 选哪个标题？（iv What to wear and what not to wear／v Free meals for staff）

点开看答案

iv　讲制服和首饰，就是穿什么不能戴什么。别被 laundry free of charge 带去 v（免费吃饭）。

…you will work alongside a ‘buddy’, an experienced member of your team…

Q3. Section C 选哪个标题？（vii Learning from experienced colleagues／x Opportunities for promotion）

点开看答案

vii　experienced colleagues = an experienced member of your team。段尾提到 training，但不是升职，别选 x。

Ask a colleague for help or use one of the trolleys kept in the storeroom.

Q9. Get help or use a ______ if a load weighs more than about 20 kg.（NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS）

点开看答案

trolley　前面有 a，填单数 trolley，填 trolleys 也算你对，但考试要注意单复数和冠词搭配。

…recorded in the accident book, which is kept at the security office.

Q14. Record every injury in the ______ at the security office.（NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS）

点开看答案

accident book　两个词 accident book，不超过两个词的要求刚好。

周三 Section 3：The Box That Changed the World（判断 + 单选 + 摘要填空）

Its importance lies not in any clever technology but in a simple idea…

Q1. Economists regard the container as important mainly because of its advanced technology.

点开看答案

FALSE　原文说重要性不在技术，而在一个简单的想法，和题目正好相反，FALSE。

…an American who owned a trucking company rather than a shipping line.

Q3. Malcom McLean had previously worked as a dock worker.

点开看答案

NOT GIVEN　只说他开卡车公司，没说当过码头工人。别脑补，NOT GIVEN。

Many of these old docklands have since been redeveloped into offices and expensive housing.

Q6. Most of the old docklands in London are now used as public parks.

点开看答案

NOT GIVEN　原文只说改成办公楼和住宅，没提公园。典型干扰，NOT GIVEN。

…although this claim is difficult to prove.

Q10. What does the writer say about the claim that containers increased trade more than trade agreements?
A It has been proved by recent research.
B It is widely rejected by economists.
C It is hard to show that it is true.
D It only applies to the United States.

点开看答案

C　difficult to prove = hard to show that it is true。注意 although 后的作者态度。

…as shipping moved to new, larger terminals further from the city centre.

Q12. Many dock workers lost their jobs, and shipping moved to new ______ , away from city centres.

点开看答案

terminals　new 已经在题干里，填 terminals，填 larger terminals 也算对。

周四 Section 1：休闲中心会员 + 花园垃圾收集通知（简答 + 句子填空）

…from 8 am to 8 pm at weekends.

Q1. What time does the centre open on Saturdays?

点开看答案

8 am　Saturday 属于 weekends，开门时间 8 am。注意别填成工作日的 6 am。

…visit reception with photo ID and proof of address…

Q6. Apart from photo ID, what must new members bring to reception?

点开看答案

proof of address　Apart from photo ID 就是另一样东西 proof of address；写 bank statement 也给分，因为是原文举的例子。

…garden waste will be collected every two weeks on Tuesdays…

Q8. Garden waste will be collected every ______ on Tuesdays.

点开看答案

two weeks　原词照抄 two weeks。别填 once a month，那是旧安排。

…please use your green caddy…

Q11. Food waste should be put in the ______

点开看答案

green caddy　两个词 green caddy，别只写 caddy。

周五 Section 2：物流公司请假制度 + 居家办公规定（特征匹配 + 选项框摘要）

Staff with at least two years’ continuous service may apply…

Q5. Employees must have worked for the company for two years.（A Annual leave　B Sick leave　C Parental leave　D Compassionate leave　E Career breaks）

点开看答案

E　two years’ continuous service = worked for two years。C 段是 26 周，别混。

…you must give at least 21 days’ notice.

Q6. Requests must be made at least three weeks beforehand.（A Annual leave　B Sick leave　C Parental leave　D Compassionate leave　E Career breaks）

点开看答案

C　21 天就是三周。A 段是两周或四周，都不是三周，这题考数字换算。

…roles that involve dealing with customers face to face.

Q9. Staff whose jobs involve meeting ______ in person are not able to apply.（选项：A probation　B customers　C trial　D allowance　E internet　F core　G print　H salary　I training　J electricity　K share　L suppliers）

点开看答案

B customers　meeting … in person = dealing with … face to face，填 customers。suppliers 原文没出现。

…but home internet costs will not be reimbursed.

Q12. However, the cost of home ______ is not paid back.（同上选项框）

点开看答案

E internet　paid back = reimbursed。electricity 是干扰项，原文说电费公司补贴 6 英镑。

…confidential documents must never be printed at home…

Q14. For security reasons, they must not ______ confidential papers at home.（同上选项框）

点开看答案

G print　must not = must never，papers = documents，填 print。training 是另一句里的干扰项，share 原文没说。

5. 写作和口语回顾（15 分钟）

题目要点按周二、周四当天的写作任务整理，措辞可能跟当天页面上的原题略有不同，意思一样。先别看范文，花 3 分钟口头说一下你每段写什么，再点开对照。绿色高亮是可以直接背下来套用的句子。

周二书信题（半正式）：给房东写信，热水器坏了

The hot water system in the flat you rent has stopped working. Write a letter to your landlord. In your letter:

  • describe the problem
  • explain how it is affecting you
  • say what you would like the landlord to do

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses. Begin your letter: Dear Mr Collins,

点开看范文（半正式语气，约 189 词）

Dear Mr Collins,

I am writing to let you know that the hot water system in the flat I rent from you at 14 Park Road has stopped working. The problem started last Sunday evening. Since then, there has been no hot water at all, and a red warning light keeps flashing on the front of the heater.

This is causing us real difficulties. We have to boil water in the kettle just to wash the dishes, and taking a shower in cold water is almost impossible now that the weather is getting colder. My daughter has also caught a cold this week, so the situation is becoming quite urgent.

Could you please arrange for a plumber to come and look at it as soon as possible? I work from home on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so either of those days would be convenient for me to let someone in. If it is easier, I am happy to contact a plumber myself, as long as you agree to cover the cost.

Thank you for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Kind regards,
Li Wei

半正式信：知道对方名字，开头 Dear Mr + 姓，结尾用 Kind regards 或 Yours sincerely。语气礼貌但不用太死板，可以用 Could you please… 这种请求句。

周四书信题（非正式）：朋友要来你的城市玩

A friend from another country is planning to visit your city. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter:

  • suggest the best time of year to visit
  • recommend some places to go
  • give advice about getting around

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter: Hi Sam,

点开看范文（非正式语气，约 189 词）

Hi Sam,

It was great to hear that you're finally coming to visit! I can't wait to show you around.

The best time to come is probably late spring, around April or May. It's warm but not too hot, and there aren't as many tourists as in the summer holidays. If I were you, I'd avoid August, because it gets really humid and crowded.

There's loads to see. You definitely have to go to the old market near the river, where you can try all kinds of street food. If you like nature, there's a mountain about an hour away by train, and the view from the top is amazing. Make sure you bring some comfortable shoes, because we'll be doing a lot of walking!

Getting around is easy. Just buy a travel card when you arrive at the airport, and you can use it on all the buses and trains. Don't bother hiring a car, because parking is expensive and the traffic is terrible.

Let me know your dates as soon as you've booked, and you can stay at my place. Can't wait to see you!

Love,
Wei

非正式信可以用缩写（I'm、you're、can't）和口语词（loads of、Don't bother），结尾用 Love、Best wishes、See you soon 都行。三个要点每个单独一段，考官最看重要点有没有写全。

周四大作文入门：城市还是乡村

Some people believe that living in a big city is better than living in the countryside. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Write at least 250 words.

点开看 7 分示范（约 264 词，四段式）

Many people move to large cities in search of better jobs and services, while others choose the peace of the countryside. Although city life has clear advantages, I disagree that it is better for everyone, because the best place to live depends largely on a person's stage of life and priorities.

On the one hand, big cities offer opportunities that are hard to find elsewhere. Most well-paid jobs are concentrated in urban areas, and public transport, hospitals and universities are usually far better than in rural regions. For young people who want to build a career or study, a city can therefore be the most practical choice. For example, a graduate in finance or technology may find dozens of suitable positions in a capital city but very few in a small town.

On the other hand, the countryside has benefits that many city residents lack. Housing is much cheaper, so families can afford a larger home with a garden. The air is cleaner, there is less noise and traffic, and people often know their neighbours, which creates a strong sense of community. These factors can have a positive effect on both physical and mental health, especially for children and older people. In addition, the slower pace of life gives people more time to spend with their families and to enjoy outdoor activities.

In conclusion, while big cities are ideal for career development and convenience, I do not believe they are better in every case. For families and those who value a calmer lifestyle, the countryside may well offer a higher quality of life.

结构：第一段改写题目加立场，第二段城市的好处加例子，第三段乡村的好处，第四段总结重申立场。立场在开头和结尾要一致，这是 Task Response 拿 7 分的关键。

口语 Part 1：本周六个话题

每个话题两道题，点开看 7 分示范答案。先自己大声说 30 秒左右，再看示范，挑一两个表达用到你自己的答案里。示范里的个人情况是通用写法，换成你自己的真实情况。

Weekends（周一）

What do you usually do at weekends?

It depends, but on Saturdays I usually have a bit of a lie-in, because I get up early all week. In the afternoon I often do some housework or go grocery shopping, and in the evening I might meet a friend for dinner. Sundays are quieter. I like to go for a long walk and spend an hour or two reviewing my English.

Do you prefer to spend weekends at home or going out?

To be honest, I'm a bit of a mix. After a busy week I really need some time at home to recharge, but if I stay in for the whole weekend I start to feel a bit restless. So ideally I'd spend one day relaxing at home and the other day going out somewhere, maybe to a park or a new café.

Shopping（周一）

Do you prefer shopping online or in shops?

For everyday things like household goods or books, I definitely prefer shopping online, because it saves a lot of time and the prices are often lower. But when it comes to clothes or shoes, I'd rather go to a shop, since I want to try them on first. I've made the mistake of ordering things online that didn't fit too many times.

Has the way people shop changed in recent years?

Yes, massively. A lot of people hardly ever go to physical shops now, apart from supermarkets. Everything can be delivered to your door, sometimes on the same day. Paying has changed too. Most people just use their phones, and I can't remember the last time I paid with cash.

Sleep（周三）

How many hours do you usually sleep?

On weekdays I usually get about six and a half hours, which is probably not quite enough. I tend to go to bed around midnight and get up at half six. At weekends I try to catch up a bit, so I might sleep for eight or nine hours, but I know that's not the healthiest pattern.

What do you do if you can't fall asleep?

If I can't drop off, I try not to look at my phone, because the screen keeps me awake even longer. Instead, I usually read a paper book for a while or listen to some quiet music. I've also noticed that if I have coffee after lunch, I sometimes lie there for hours, so I've cut down on that.

Food and Cooking（周三）

Do you like cooking?

Yes, I do, although I don't have much time for it on weekdays. During the week I usually make something quick and simple, like stir-fried vegetables with rice. At the weekend, though, I enjoy trying out new recipes. Cooking is quite relaxing for me, and it's much healthier and cheaper than eating out all the time.

What kind of food is popular in your country?

Rice and noodles are definitely the basics, and people eat a lot of vegetables, tofu and pork. Dumplings are really popular too, especially during the Spring Festival, when families get together and make them by hand. These days, though, fast food and food delivery are becoming more and more common, particularly among young people.

Weather（周五）

What's the weather like where you live?

Where I live, the summers are hot and very humid, and we get quite a lot of rain in June. Winters are fairly cold and dry, but it doesn't snow very often. My favourite time of year is autumn, because the sky is clear, the temperature is comfortable and it's perfect for walking.

Does the weather affect your mood?

Yes, I think it does. When it's sunny I feel more energetic and I'm more likely to go out and do things. On grey, rainy days I tend to feel a bit low and I just want to stay in. Really hot weather is the worst for me, because it makes me tired and it's hard to concentrate at work.

Music（周五）

What kind of music do you like?

I've got quite broad taste, but I mostly listen to pop and a bit of jazz. Pop is great when I'm commuting or exercising, because it's upbeat and keeps me going. Jazz is more for the evenings, when I want to unwind. Recently I've also started listening to English songs to help with my listening skills.

Did you learn to play a musical instrument when you were a child?

Yes, my parents sent me to piano lessons when I was about eight. I have to admit I didn't enjoy practising very much, and I gave up after three or four years because of schoolwork. Looking back, I kind of regret it, and I'd like to pick it up again one day if I have the time.

6. 自查清单

  • 主词表遮住中文，至少能说出 96 个意思（大约 85%）。
  • 15 个听写词至少对 12 个，错的抄三遍。
  • 24 个听力表达能说出中文意思，并且至少能用 5 个各造一句。
  • 阅读易错题每道都能指出原文对应句，说清楚错在哪：没读全段、单复数、数字换算，还是干扰词。
  • 能分清正式、半正式、非正式三种书信的开头结尾，两封范文的高亮句能默写一半以上。
  • 大作文能说出四段式结构，每段第一句写什么。
  • 六个口语话题每题都能连续说 20 到 30 秒，不卡壳。

写好的书信、大作文，或者口语录音转成的文字，直接发到聊天里，我帮你批改，告诉你大概几分、哪里可以改。
